pointer_semantics.authority_commit: dataset authority commit of the frozen funding/OI/price foundation (6e42dd9d4c19800925fd555999686d1e2b4ef47e)
pointer_semantics.generated_from_commit: git HEAD of research/arc01-data-authority-01 at artifact generation time (pre-freeze parent); recorded as a short SHA
pointer_semantics.self_reference_policy: No artifact records its own hash or the SHA of the commit that contains it; PREREG_COMMIT is resolved externally as the SHA of the commit whose message is '[ARC01-PREREG-001] freeze funding crowding unwind discovery'. This avoids a commit loop that exists only to embed its own SHA.

prereg_commit_resolution: git rev-parse HEAD of the commit whose message starts with '[ARC01-PREREG-001]' on branch research/arc01-data-authority-01

frozen_summary.decision_cadence: one decision per certified funding settlement instant per asset
frozen_summary.funding_extreme: robust z >= +2.0 (short) / <= -2.0 (long), trailing 60d closed window, min 90 obs, median location, 1.4826*MAD scale, MAD=0 -> sample stdev -> else NO_SIGNAL
frozen_summary.oi_confirmation: oi_change_24h = last eligible sum_open_interest / value 24h earlier - 1 must be STRICTLY > 0
frozen_summary.entry: first 1h bar OPEN strictly after decision_time
frozen_summary.exit: 1h bar OPEN 72h after entry bar open, unconditional
frozen_summary.overlap: SKIP same-asset signals while open; independent per-asset positions, max 3 concurrent
frozen_summary.cost_model: 10 bps primary round trip total; sensitivities 0/10/20/40 bps
frozen_summary.funding_cashflow: APPLIED for settlements in (entry_time, exit_time]; information window ends at decision_time
frozen_summary.kill_rule: one preregistration -> one primary discovery; failure is terminal (DISCOVERY_FAIL)

immutability: After PREREG_COMMIT the nine frozen content artifacts are immutable. Any change requires a new preregistration (new hypothesis id), never an edit of this one.
